<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import csv
import os

INPUT_FILE = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
REPORT_FILE = "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv"
SELECTED_FILE = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"

# Read the input matrix
with open(INPUT_FILE, "r", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    fieldnames = reader.fieldnames
    rows = list(reader)

# Identify indicator columns (everything except city_id, city_name, year)
non_indicator_cols = {"city_id", "city_name", "year"}
indicator_cols = [c for c in fieldnames if c not in non_indicator_cols]

total_rows = len(rows)

# Compute missingness per indicator
missing_counts = {}
missing_rates = {}
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = sum(1 for row in rows if row[col] is None or row[col].strip() == "")
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_rows if total_rows > 0 else 0.0
    missing_counts[col] = missing_count
    missing_rates[col] = missing_rate

# Determine which indicators to keep (missing_rate <= 0.30)
kept_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if missing_rates[col] <= 0.30]

# Write missingness report
with open(REPORT_FILE, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
    writer.writerow(["indicator", "missing_count", "missing_rate", "kept"])
    for col in indicator_cols:
        kept_str = "True" if col in kept_indicators else "False"
        writer.writerow([col, missing_counts[col], missing_rates[col], kept_str])

# Write selected matrix
selected_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"] + kept_indicators
with open(SELECTED_FILE, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
    writer.writerow(selected_cols)
    for row in rows:
        writer.writerow([row[c] if row[c] is not None else "" for c in selected_cols])
</solution_file>
